text: I love it, simple with a great layout. After choosing a class and either exam/reminder/task, it would be nice to have my schedule pop up so I can pick a class to connect it to. At the moment an ordinary calendar shows up and it can be difficult to remember what day I have which class if all I remember is "the exam is next class". Another small thing I would like is customization, I'm not very fond of the turquoise color. :)
